title: Chef / Cook
raw_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Chef / Cook
Full-Time | Restaurant / Hotel / Catering Kitchen
Experience: 2+ Years    Department: Food Production / Kitchen
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled and reliable Chef / Cook to prepare high-quality meals while maintaining excellent
standards of taste, presentation, hygiene, and food safety. The successful candidate will assist with menu
preparation, ingredient planning, kitchen organization, stock control, and coordination with kitchen staff to ensure
smooth daily operations.
Key Responsibilities
•
Prepare and cook dishes according to recipes, menu specifications, portion sizes, and quality standards.
•
Plan daily food preparation and organize mise en place before service.
•
Inspect ingredients for freshness, quality, and correct storage; rotate stock using FIFO practices.
•
Maintain cleanliness and sanitation of workstations, utensils, cooking equipment, and storage areas.
•
Follow food safety practices, including safe food handling, temperature control, and prevention of
cross-contamination.
•
Assist with menu planning, recipe development, portion control, and presentation of dishes.
•
Monitor ingredient usage, minimize food waste, and report stock shortages to the supervisor.
•
Coordinate with kitchen assistants, stewards, service staff, and other chefs during busy service periods.
•
Follow dietary requirements and communicate allergen-related information accurately.
•
Support kitchen inventory, ordering, receiving supplies, and checking deliveries as assigned.
Must-Have Requirements
•
At least 2 years of experience as a Chef, Cook, or Commis Chef in a restaurant, hotel, catering service, or similar
kitchen.
•
Practical cooking skills and knowledge of food preparation techniques.
•
Understanding of food hygiene, sanitation, safe storage, and food safety procedures.
•
Ability to follow recipes, measure ingredients, manage portions, and maintain consistent quality.
•
Knowledge of stock rotation, basic inventory control, and minimizing food waste.
•
Ability to work efficiently under pressure and manage time during meal service.
•
Teamwork, communication, attention to detail, and willingness to follow kitchen procedures.
Nice-to-Have Requirements
•
Culinary arts certificate, hotel management qualification, or relevant vocational training.
•
Experience with menu costing, recipe standardization, and food cost control.
•
Knowledge of multiple cuisines or specialized cooking methods.
•
Experience with bulk cooking, buffet service, banquet preparation, or catering.
•
Knowledge of food allergen procedures and dietary-specific meal preparation.
•
Familiarity with kitchen inventory or point-of-sale systems.

Education and Training
A culinary arts, hotel management, or food production qualification is preferred. Equivalent hands-on kitchen
experience may be considered.
Core Skills
Kitchen: Food preparation, cooking, seasoning, plating, portion control, menu execution, ingredient handling,
stock rotation, inventory support, and kitchen sanitation.
Professional: Time management, teamwork, communication, adaptability, consistency, problem-solving, and
attention to detail.
Selection Process
•
Resume screening.
•
Practical cooking or food preparation test.
•
Interview on kitchen experience, hygiene, and food safety.
•
Final discussion on shifts, responsibilities, and availability.
Success Criteria
The successful candidate will consistently prepare safe, flavorful, well-presented dishes, maintain a clean and
organized kitchen, control waste, follow food safety procedures, and work effectively with the kitchen team.
